items.title: New frontier models evaluated
items.body: We evaluated Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT-5.5 on GeoCodeBench. Results are now on the leaderboard.

items.title: GeoCodeBench benchmark released
items.body: We are excited to announce the release of GeoCodeBench, along with an online leaderboard.
